nom: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Firmness and Elasticity

avis.titre: THIS IS THE 2ND TIME I AM PURCHASING THE SERUM.
avis.texte: I LIKE HOW THIS SERUM GOES ON. IT IS SMOOTH AND NOT TOO RUNNY LIKE ANOTHER ONE I'VE TRIED. IT DOES SEEM TO KEEP MY FACE A BIT FIRMER, BECAUSE I NOTICE A DIFFERENCE WHEN I DON'T USE IT SO OFTEN. I WILL CONTINUE TO USE THIS SERUM. PLUS I LOVE THE ORDINARY !

I previously used the hyaluronic serum with vitamin B something and loved it. Switched to this one expecting even better smoothing and moisture. It's been about a month. My skin doesn't look or feel any different after using this daily. Definitely not for me.

avis.titre: I I would buy this product at this reasonably price often.
avis.texte: The ordinary multi peptide serum has many great ingredients. I just am not certain they are in the most effective amount. I wish I saw more amazing results, but perhaps if I did not use it my skin would appear more aged.

I have been using this product for over a year now, and will continue using it for forever. I drop a few drops in the palm of my hand, and pat it onto my face using my fingertips, spreading it from forehead to neck. It sits well on my skin, therefore, you certainly can feel the firmness and elasticity without feeling "tight". The Ordinary products are very effective and very reasonable.

I tried this serum every night for about a week but unfortunately it burned when I applied it and after a couple days caused me to break out on my cheeks/get little bumps all over the rest of my face. I have dry skin that isn't usually sensitive or acne prone. Not sure I used it long enough to see sny effects but if anything my fine lines looked worse the week I used this product.

I've used the regular Hyaluronic Acid serum for a few years now which works great for my skin! Saw this and picked it up as the addition of peptides is a nice benefit. So far so good! I think I prefer this to the regular Hyaluronic Acid serum.

avis.titre: Visible results, light texture and good price
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for several weeks and I've been surprised at how well it works. The texture is light, absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky feeling. I have noticed my skin firmer, hydrated and with better elasticity. It also helps the skin look smoother and healthier. I love that it works well combined with other products and did not cause me irritation, even with daily use. For the price, the quality is excellent. I would definitely buy it again.

This is my first bottle of Multi-Peptide + Hyaluronic Acid Serum. I have been using just the Hyaluronic Serum for months now, but saw this, and decided to give it a try. I love it. I like that it includes the peptides in the formula….it's like 2 in 1. It comes with a dropper, and I just put 2 drops in the palm of my hand and dot it on my face and neck. It's a watery consistency, that's why I put it in the palm of my hand and use my finger. It may be a tad tacky for a few seconds, but dries down quickly. In my opinion, it tightens the skin in a natural way. My skin looks smoother and my makeup goes on well, without pilling. I use several of The Ordinary products and will continue to do so. A little goes a long way and they are very affordable.
I like that this product helps keep my skin hydrated through out the day. Such an affordable product as well

First product that actually brightened my face. I have fair skin with a lot of freckles. My skin looks so much brighter after only 3rd day of use. Love that it doesn't have a strong smell like some other products. Price is great too which means I'll repurchase.
I enjoyed the light texture of this serum. My face feels smoother. No weird smells, which is a plus!
Made my skin tingle and was so tacky I had to wash it off after 10 minutes.

The ordinary Buffet was great. This stuff, on the other hand, gives me horrible acne. My face stays clear unless I use this stuff, and every single time I use it I get like 4 pimples by the emd of tge day. Stay far away if you are acne prone.

Im not sure about the bad reviews for this. Its a holy grail product for me. Light and hydrating. But most of all, the effect it has on my skin texture is amazing. My skin looks smoothet and pires mych less noticeable. I can tell when i skip this serum for a few days. For reference i have combination sensitive skin.

I noticed i was beginning to get some fine smile lines and went on a hunt for a good serum to add to my skincare routine. This particular one is working wonderfully. My skin looks plump and hydrated after applying and the affects are continuing to build up the longer i use it. Three drops goes a long ways. I appreciate that, unlike other serums, this one is smoothing and adds a healthy glow without being tacky and sticky. My skin is soft, smooth and the fine lines are less noticeable.

I noticed i was beginning to get some fine smile lines and went on a hunt for a good serum to add to my skincare routine. This particular one is working wonderfully. My skin looks plump and hydrated after applying and the affects are continuing to build up the longer i use it. Three drops goes a long ways. I appreciate that, unlike other serums, this one is smoothing and adds a healthy glow without being tacky and sticky. My skin is soft, smooth and the fine lines are less noticeable.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again.
avis.texte: Keep in mind I have weird overly sensitive skin. This gave me a crazy amount of little white heads and cheek pimples almost instantly (with a few days). I typically do not have that issue with a water-based product. Not sure if anyone else had this same issue

I've come to rely on the ordinary for affordable yet effective products; the essence which was gifted by the ordinary for honest review is gentle for those with sensitive eczema prone skin. The texture is watery like a toner and I use it as the first layer after cleansing. The product leaves the the skin feeling soft and rehydrated and makes a great base for heavier moisturizers and creams.

I really like this product!!!! I really feel the difference on my face, I like the soft that the product do in my skin. this products is designed to be gentle and can be incorporated into most skincare routines, although always patch test first. I can't explain how this product do my face 😍😍

I love this product it was amazing. I made my skin feel so nice. I like this a lot and will probably keep buy this form now on. The container was nice and sturdy. I liked how affordable this product is as well. Gifted by theordinary

I'm really impressed with its performance – it glides on effortlessly and deeply nourishes my skin. My face stays hydrated and feels refreshed all day. I'm thrilled with how effective it is and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a quality product. Many thanks to for gifted by The Ordinary!
Nice product, but please, please, add the larger size, this one is tiny and barely lasts over a month.

I was so grateful to be gifted by The Ordinary for being able to have this opportunity to be able to test this new product. I have always loved everything I have tried and an essence is my favorite my far always. I apply it during my AM and PM skincare routine and I cannot express how much I love the results this provides for my skin. . It protects and strengthens the skin barrier. Which is vital for skin health. It feels very light going on, almost like water and sinks into your skin extremely quickly with no sticky feeling and no greasy residue. My skin is glowing from within after use and just looks so healthy and luminous. It also lasts all day. If used at night, you wake up with the same results. I do wear makeup and it hasn't caused me any issues with other makeup or skincare used in tandem which often happens. Also I must mention that this product has made my skin so beautiful and glowing I have had the confidence to skip makeup overall. My skin looks that good and heathy. Overall I think this is an amazing product and especially for the price point it's a no brainer. The Ordinary has something for everyone and the products are such great quality and always thinks of the consumers with the pricing. Definitely recommend this and anything from the brand I have had the pleasure of trying out. It's also a huge plus because compared to ANYTHING else on the market it's so much cheaper priced but trust me the quality is top notch. My advice would not be afraid and just try a
This stuff is the best worth every penny try it out TODAY !!!!
This has seemed to improve the look & texture of my skin. I love The Ordinary's products and feel like they make my skin glow!

avis.titre: I have purchased this product since September 2021
avis.texte: I have bought this product every two months, since September 2021, my skin is more beautiful, natural, changes are visible on my face. I have combined it with other The Ordinary products

I love how this serum plumps my lips and whole face when I apply each evening over my moisturizer prior to going to bed. I put this serum on lips after I put on a moisturizing lip mask. And wow my lips look great the next morning.
Love the application. A little bit goes a long way. Doesn't have a strong smell & it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

Chemical burn from using this one time. Look at the pic. Bright red and purple. My face has been like this all day. It is extremely hot and is making me feel sick. This is only in the areas that I used this product.
I have been using this product for about a week now day and night. I have noticed a huge difference on my face. It appears smoother and healthier. Would highly recommend.

This serum has all you need. It combats so many different types of skin issues. Not just wrinkles and fine lines. I have such a healthy glow to my skin now and no more oily/dry skin. Ive never felt better about my skin.

since 2021 I've mostly been using this. I occasionally try other products, but this is ol' reliable. I prefer not too many actives in the AM, but it's nice to have peptides and amino acids to help hydrate & start the day. I am just starting to develop fine lines, so I can't say that this helps with it (can't stop aging, it'll happen eventually 😜) but this serum keeps the dullness away and gives a bit of that skincare glow (thank you, peptides!)

avis.titre: Wanted to love but irritated my…
avis.texte: Bought it for the 1st time ever and used it on my neck and face for about a week. I spent 1 day in the sun, in a river, and applied my usual sunscreen. The next day, I woke up with a red bumpy rash on my neck/chest area. My face has no rash, but I have yet to see an improvement. It does make my skin feel very dry afterwards-make sure to moisturize.

I got this because it was availabke in store i usually just get the agrielene solution but stores dontcreally carry that..you have to order it from somewhere.. this is very sticky snd pills under makeup .. didnt see much change in my skin either
Love this. Use it daily. Feels great on my skin. It's affordable and quality.

avis.titre: My spouse noticed enough of a difference we repurchased it
avis.texte: My skincare avoidant spouse used a bottle of this and noticed a difference when he ran out. He actually asked that we drop by Ulta to pick one up for him. I picked one up for myself, as well. This serum layers well with other products without balling up. I use it AM and PM and am enjoying seeing reduced lines around the eyes and an overall smoother skin appearance.

I've been using this on and off for 4 years now. some of the time I use this but would see a new serum pop up and see if it's the same... but I always come back to this! only downside is that the price is creeping up a bit. still totally worth it, still very affordable for great results. gives me a healthy glow, and is one product that really makes my skin feel hydrated/plump

I used this formula for a couple of years, and i loved it. I just purchased a new bottle, and holy moly, my skin has never looked worse. Red, inflamed, cracked in the corners of mouth, creeping under eyes. Stay away!!
Great multi peptide serum and HA. Feels great and readies face for other serums
Want to love this but it peels way too much i have no choice but to try something else

avis.titre: I noticed a difference in three days
avis.texte: Maybe it's a placebo effect but I noticed my skin looking brighter, smoother and firmer in just a few days. I had just grabbed this on a whim while I was getting something else, but now it's definitely going into the regular routine.

avis.titre: Didn't Appreciate Until I Ran Out
avis.texte: I think this product is great for skin texture, brightness, and dryness. I teally didnt appreciate how much it was helping my skin until I ran out and suddenly my skin just looked like garbage (dull, bad texture). I have very reactive, sensitive skin with Rosacea and am prone to severe Rosacea texture issues (hard patches of skin, rough texture, flakiness). When I use this I have almost none of those issues.
I've been using this for years since it was called buffet. It can be a bit sticky but it works to help skin tone and texture. the pricepoint is great too. Lasts a long time as well.

My face was looking amazing until i decided to try this..I used this about 3 times in a week. Today I noticed my face felt horrible, super textured. Right now before bed I looked in the mirror and I have a ton of tiny bumps all over my face. Some have tiny white heads others are bigger and itchy like hives. My skin is not very sensitive but I've never had a reaction like this.

I've been using it for years now. It's helped even out skin texture and hydration. During the pandemic, I started to focus on setting up a proper skincare routine. My sister recommended this. For the first couple of years, I used it morning and night after washing face and followed up by a moisturizer. Now I use it in the morning (retinol at night now). Any time I've run out and thought I'd be fine without it, my skin starts acting up; so I start using this again and my skin clears up quickly. For reference, I'm 38 years old with dry skin.

I'm 42 year old white lady (eastern euro). When I tell people my age, they're shocked. I credit 27 years of vegetarianism, proper nutrition, the minimum recommended exercise, healthy sleep, sunscreen, never skipping my skincare routine, and of course, the incorporation of this product. It makes my skin texture incredibly smooth and combats fine lines. I always keep a back stock and will never be without.

I have been using this product for almost a year… and the results are amazing. its very hydrating, and helped my acne so much. if your worried about sensitive skin, i have it and had no reaction to it. the only thing i find wrong with it is that it makes my pours slightly larger right after use, but calms down about 30 minutes or so after. i also have acne prone skin, so this really worked.

Either my skin just doesn't like this product or I had an allergic reaction to it. My skin has always been pretty clear with very little marks or acne, but this serum gave me tons of acne-like bumps all over my face. The day I stopped using it, I almost instantly noticed the spots fading and they stop appearing altogether. If you have sensitive skin I would not recommend or I would at least look thoroughly at the ingredients.
I've been using this under moisturizer daily for just under 2 months, and it has had no noticeable effect on the moisture or suppleness of my skin. Zero anti-aging benefits. You get what you pay for.

This is my go-to Ordinary product, along with the Niacinamide. I use this every night and my skin has never been better. The product results and the price keep me coming back for more! I highly, highly recommend.
Past my mid 30s, and thus eliminated the dynamic wrinkles on my forehead. I apply after cleansing/showering in the morning, then an spf on top, no issues with piling. Highly recommend.

I've been looking into adding peptides into my routine as I'm 30 now and wanting to keep looking 30 for the next 10 years lol. this stuff was not it. it has a weird sticky texture and made my skin look sticky too... and even worse every time I used it I broke out so bad. id stop for 2 weeks, then try again and still breakout so I know it was this stuff. im so sad, ill have to try something else!

avis.titre: Great addition to m skincare routine!
avis.texte: I have dry sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my skin at all and had no reaction when patch tested. I only been using it long enuff to use half a bottle but already see improvements in my skin (I will update after longer use). My skin isn't as red and my irritation marks have drastically improved. Skin skin looks and feels softer and smoother like it's already starting to improve my texture. That alone makes it worth it and can't wait to see what other improvement lay ahead with further use. I use this every morning and every night except on the nights that I use my lactic acid serum which is about 2-3 times a week. I gently smooth it over my face and neck then gently press it in to my skin then let it sit a cpl minutes before applying my moisturizer. The price is higher than I expected for this brand but for this product and the fact that's its already improving my skin I say it's worth it. I just gave some to my mom to try yesterday so if she has no irritation then will get her a bottle and see how it works for both of us together. I highly recommend atleast trying this product if ur in ur 20s or older. Everyone can benefit from a product like this!

This stopped my dynamic forehead wrinkles. For reference I am in my mid to late 30s, while I still look young for my age, I would like to minimize the "giveaways" and would like to avoid having to go back to fillers and injections. I use this in the morning after shower. No issues with pilling when applying sunscreen or foundation after either.
I didn't use this for a few weeks and my skin was awful!! I hasn't realized how much this was keeping my acne under control. And whatever ones did appear healed in 2 days!

avis.titre: I will buy this again for sure!
avis.texte: This product is lightweight serum that has greatly improved my fine lines in a short period of time. It is also non irritating, would be good for sensitive skin.
This was way too strong for me. It had given me migranes. It did not break me out or anything. I do have some of their other products that I do love.

I got one bottle of this product a couple of months ago, it was ok-ish until it wasn't :-/ On my second bottle first usage I got a terrible allergy reaction, my face got tight, swollen to a point of looking like I had a thick mask over my face and neck, my skin got rough like a block of brick, complete disaster, palpitations, to a point where I had to be taken to the clinic, just horror, I had to be injected with steroids, and be out on treatment. To that point I did not know what had caused all that, until yesterday when, I slowly tried to get back into my nightly routine, so I put a little of this product, with a light mooisturizer that I've been wearing for a long time, and boom! This morning I'm back to a swollen face and neck, just horrible! I didn't want to believe the rumors because I was a big fan of this brand, but after all the medical bills and this horrible experience, I rather paying a bit more and moving to a more responsible, better quality, customer focused brand. Thus is just awful stuff. Just not worth all the risks and medicak visits, just to save a couple bucks, for this company not to even make a quality product and not mess up your face like that, be aware ladies& gentleman, just not worth it. Very dissapointed on this brand :-(
This caused me to break out and I didn't see an improvement in my fine lines
I have used all ordinary products, but this one was the best. It's perfect for wrinkles, pores and the hydration of the skin. Loved it and won't stop using it.
I really wanted to like this stuff, but on top of seeing no results whatsoever, it also caused my skin to burn and always leaves me waking up to new breakouts.

I've only been using this for about a week. No bad reactions, but only time will tell if this works well for my skin. I feel like the aha/bha peel 1x/week and rose oil everyday has changed my skin drastically-in a good way. I was using the Estée Lauder peptide serum for months before this. It did make a noticeable difference in my skin, but I cannot afford the splurge. Since that serum took about 3 weeks before it really changed my skin I'm hoping this one will work too. 🤞🏻
Every time I buy this the price keeps going up! Just wondering since a big corporation has taken over the ordinary they have increased the prices on all ordinary products greatly!
This is very sticky and does not absorb well into the skin. It feels like it just sits on top and then anything I use after it feels like it does not absorb either.
I have been using this product in my daily routine and have notice my face feeling more plump. Will definitely keep using.
Great serum that I use at least once a day. Incorporates wonderfully into a multi-step routine. Price point is fantastic!

I wanted to love this whole line, I have bought so many items and every night I used it, the next morning I felt like I had this weird smell. I couldn't stand it. Maybe it was just my reaction to the product? I tried not using the product and used something else and no weird smell. I have quit using all of it and threw it away. I no longer have that weird smell when wake up. I haven't heard of anyone complaining of this, but that's the experience I had.

avis.titre: Fabulous stuff for a fraction of the cost of others!
avis.texte: I've just tried my first TO products for about a month, and I'm loving them. I did the Build a Regimen and it started me on 1) Squalane cleanser 2) Ascorbyl Tetra 20% in Vit F 3) MultiPeptide +HA and 4) Moisturizing Factors +HA. I introduced them one at a time, no problems with any of them. I am really excited about this one. The Multi-Peptide + HA serum was showing visible results in as little as a week. My skin is much smoother, and the lines are starting to smooth out a bit. Most noticeably on the lines between my brows and my laugh lines. I even tried a drop on the back of my hands and it made a huge difference- less crepey, and brighter looking. I'm 60, and I think this was a good group of products to try out first. I may try some of the others after a while, but I'm very pleased so far. I mean I seriously can't stop touching my skin, it feels so great!

I'm on my second bottle now and use twice a day. I can totally see and feel more plumpness in my skin and I feel like it makes my makeup sit better as well. I have my friends hooked on it as well. Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Exactly what I was looking for
avis.texte: After years of struggling with acne as a 30 something, having basically perfect skin my whole life up until now for some reason, I finally found a routine that seems to work. I've taken my routine to the most basic level because my skin is incredibly sensitive and doing too much only seemed to make it worse. I only use the garnier rose micellar water for cleansing, the occasional use of an AHA around my time of the month when I break out the worst, and the dramatically different gel moisturizer from Clinique. The only thing I was missing was some kind of anti-aging product to help fill out these small lines developing on my forehead, around my eyes and smile lines. This seems to have done the trick. I've had no reaction so far, my skin is smooth and best of all PLUMP. Something I haven't seen in what feels like years. I don't find it sticky, especially applying moisturizer after, and it doesn't have a smell. Now to find a good oil free sunscreen that won't break me out and I'll be set!
My skin reacted very bad to this. Hives and small bumps/extreme dryness. I wish it worked but going to try to return it and try something else.

This is really hydrating under a moisturizer, and it seems to calm some of my redness too. I don't actually notice any anti aging besides the hydration which makes my skin look more plump, but I still love it. It's a nice texture that's not too watery.

I'm sure it works great for some skin types but I had an allergic reaction. My face was covered in hives and peeling and my eyes swelled shut. The reaction took about 6 hours before I noticed anything was off, peaked around 18 hours and took about 4 days for the swelling to go down. Three weeks later I still have a patch of skin from the peeling that isn't back to normal. Moral of the story: ALWAYS patch test and wait the recommended 72 hours

avis.titre: Thought I liked it, but caused me to break out.
avis.texte: I used this on and off again. On the nights I used it I would wake up with tiny bumps/pimples on my face. I did research and found dermatologists saying the molecules in the formula are too large which cause clogged pores.
I started using this at night and see a nice difference in smoothness.
This is NOT the same as the Buffet they used to have. This broke me out whereas the original one never did! Why discontinue a great product?!

I figured it was time to review after 2 years of using this aka "buffet". My skin is sensitive and combination so maybe it works differently for others but this saved my skin. I live in an area where winter season is dry and very cold but with this my skin is NEVER dry or flaky. I used to always get eczema around my eyes and after using this I haven't had a breakout since. Even when I got breakouts on my arm I'd put this on to help. It dries nicely for me as well.

I've been using this serum for years and won't be stopping anytime soon. I apply after cleansing in the morning and love how moisturized it makes my skin- I feel like there is a noticeable plumping effect. I don't personally mind the subtle stickiness as I typically apply makeup shortly after using however, I have found that the stickiness can be eliminated if serum application is followed by an LED face mask.

avis.titre: I would buy anything from The Ordinary
avis.texte: The ordinary puts out the absolute best skincare products. I use their serum, cleanser and moisterizer. I hope they never stop making these products. Their products are no fluff, no fuss just real ingredients that work.
I use this after cleansing morning and night. It's well formulated with good peptides. It's been a mainstay in my skincare for several years. I use in under moisturizer and sunscreen.

Extremely uncomfortable on the skin. it doesn't feel like your skin is actually absorbing anything, its just a thick and sticky layer that sits on top. Even if you layer with another serum or moisturizer, you still feel sticky for hours. The thickness made my skin feel as though it could not "breathe" so it also made my face sweat. Used as directed for a full month and had no changes to my skin.
I wanted to love this but it made my whole face super puffy and red. I used it before bed and woke up with my face all swollen and uncomfortable. 😭😭😭

For those of you who don't know, this is the same product as the Buffet—just renamed. At first, this gave amazing hydration for the first hour and throughout the day, I kept noticing that my face was feeling irritated and tight yet shiny. My friends even pointed out that my pores looked larger than ever. I have this a solid weeks try and everyday got worse and worse. The hyaluronic acid in is it not for everyone. I wanted this to work so badly cause I love this brand and the price point, but my skin was so irritated. Once I stopped, my skin immediately was calmed down.
